RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

An all-female panel alone is not evidence of sex discrimination. In public broadcasting, hiring decisions typically rely on structured scoring criteria across interviews and specific competencies. While you have longer overall tenure, eight years is substantial, and her "strong experience of digital media" highlights a critical strategic capability for modern newsrooms.

Raising the panel's gender composition without concrete evidence of bias would appear unprofessional, damaging your working relationships and internal reputation. A two-week wait for written feedback is also standard administrative delay, not necessarily avoidance. Instead, follow up politely on your feedback request, focusing entirely on your interview performance, skill development, and future opportunities.
